bundle.shortDescription: Three-way merge window for every conflicted file of a git merge
bundle.longDescription: yamt opens all conflicted files of a stopped git merge, rebase or cherry-pick in one window: your side on the left, theirs on the right, the result in the middle, with arrows to apply each change. Marking a file resolved stages it.
